# Logged-in HF screens: browser capture (2026-10-06, ~18:15–18:44Z)

**Manual capture, not generated by a script.** The account owner logged in to huggingface.co in the
desktop app's built-in browser, first as `OwnerOfTheGatedModel`, then as `TestingBOrig`. The agent only
viewed pages, opened dialogs, typed into search boxes and ticked/unticked a checkbox. It submitted
nothing, clicked no Accept/Reject/Grant/Cancel, and changed no setting. Facts were extracted with page
JavaScript (DOM, `data-props` of server-rendered components) and the browser's network log. CSRF tokens
and e-mail addresses were not kept.

Sandbox state during the capture: `OwnerOfTheGatedModel/tiny-gated-model`, `gated: "manual"`,
notifications `bulk`, one request (`TestingBOrig`, pending, submitted 2026-10-06T14:42:55.348Z).

## Owner (`OwnerOfTheGatedModel`)

### Model page `/{repo}`
- No `RepoGatedModal`. A block in the page shows the heading **"Gated model"** and the line
  **"You have been granted access to this model"**.
- `ModelHeader` props: `canReadRepoSettings: true`, `canWriteRepoContent: true`, `model.gated: "manual"`.

### Settings `/{repo}/settings`: one component, `ViewerSettingsContent`
- Its server props carry the gating config that the API does not expose (CFG-3): `objectInfo.gated:
  "manual"`, `objectInfo.gatedNotifications: {"mode": "bulk"}` (no `email` key when none is set),
  `objectInfo.orgMembersGated: false`.
- The section text matches the documentation: "Gated user access", "Access requests are currently
  enabled for this model.", the explanatory paragraph, `New requests:`, `Review access requests (1)`,
  `Download user access report`, `Add access`, `Notifications frequency`, `Notifications email`,
  `Disable Access requests`.
- Controls:
  - `New requests:` is a `<select>` with options `auto=Automatic approval`, `manual=Manual review`
    (selected), outside any form, so it is driven by JavaScript.
  - The notifications form has no action and no submit button. It holds a `<select>` with options
    `bulk=Once a day` (selected) and `real-time=Real-time`, and an `<input type="email"
    placeholder="example@example.com">`. A tooltip says "When to receive notifications about new
    access requests.".
  - `Disable Access requests` is a `<button type="submit">` in a form with
    `action="/api/models/{repo}/settings"`, containing a hidden input `gated=false`.

### "Review access requests (1)" → dialog
- **Requests fired** when it opens: `GET /api/models/{repo}/user-access-request/pending?limit=100`,
  `…/accepted?limit=100`, `…/rejected?limit=100`. There is **no `reset` list**. The page URL gains
  `?gated_access_request=true`.
- It is a native `<dialog>` titled "Manage access requests", with a close button (icon only).
- **Tabs** are plain `<button>`s labelled `pending (1)`, `accepted (0)`, `rejected (0)`. There is no
  `role="tab"` and no reset tab.
- **Search:** `<input type="search" placeholder="Search requests">`. Typing `testing` fires one
  debounced request, for the current tab only: `GET …/pending?limit=100&q=testing`. The dialog then
  shows "1 matching result".
- **Bulk selection:** a checkbox labelled "Select all" and one checkbox per row, labelled
  `Select access request from TestingBOrig`, whose value is the user `_id`. Ticking a row shows
  "1 selected", **"Accept selected"** and **"Reject selected"**.
- **Row:** the username links to `/TestingBOrig`, followed by the e-mail, the relative time ("about 4
  hours ago") and the buttons `Accept` and `Reject`.
- **Pagination:** links `Previous` and `Next`.
- **Escape** closes the dialog and removes `?gated_access_request=true`.

### "Add access" → dialog
- The URL gains `?gated_add_user=true`. The dialog is titled "Add a user access manually". It has
  `<input type="text" placeholder="Start typing to search for a user">` and a separate **`Grant
  access`** button, disabled until a user is chosen.
- **Requests fired:** `GET /api/quicksearch?q=&type=user` when the dialog opens, then
  `GET /api/quicksearch?q=TestingB&type=user` while typing.
- The response has `"users": []`, even with the browser session, and even for `TestingBOrig` or
  `julien-c`. The dialog shows **"No results found :("**.

### File page `/{repo}/blob/main/checkpoint-0/config.json` (with access)
- It is a full file viewer: the last commit ("Upload tiny random GPT-2 sandbox model", `5bb9fc5`,
  VERIFIED) and a Download box with "Download file 819 Bytes" linking to
  `resolve/main/…?download=true`, the copyable link, the `hf download` and `curl` commands. Then come
  the links Raw, History, Blame, Edit, Delete, and finally the content. There is no gate box.

- The form starts collapsed behind a button "Expand to review and access" (`type="button"`). Clicking

- The submit button is "Submit" (`extra_gated_button_content`).

## Session 2: state-changing steps approved by the account owner (~18:55–19:05Z)

The account owner approved "group 1" (state changes on the sandbox, observed in the browser). Requests
were logged by a same-origin `fetch` hook in the page. Native `confirm()`/`prompt()` were stubbed to
record their text. Requester e-mails, CSRF and WAF tokens were not kept.

### Requester (`TestingBOrig`)
- **Self-cancel** from `/settings/gated-repos`: the icon button "Cancel this access request" opens a
  **native `confirm()`: "Are you sure you want to cancel this access request?"**. On OK it sends
  `POST /api/models/{repo}/user-access-request/cancel` (no body) → `200`. The row disappears without a
  page reload.
- With **no request** on the manual sandbox (no custom button), the form button is **"Agree and send
  request to access repo"**. There is no Cancel button and no `accessRequestStatus` prop.
- **Submit**: native form POST to `/{repo}/ask-access?next=/{repo}`. The navigation records one redirect
  (`redirectCount: 1`, the 303) and lands on the repo page in A3 ("Your request to access this
  repository has been submitted…"), with `accessRequestStatus: "pending"`. No toast or extra message.

### Owner (`OwnerOfTheGatedModel`), "Manage access requests"
- On page load the button reads "Review access requests" with no number, then `(1)` once loaded.
- **Accept** (pending tab) sends `POST /api/models/{repo}/user-access-request/handle` with JSON
  `{"status":"accepted","userId":"<user _id>"}` → `200 {}`. The UI then refetches **only**
  `…/pending?limit=100` and `…/accepted?limit=100`, stays on the pending tab, which now reads **"No
  pending access requests"**, and the settings button becomes **"Review access requests (0)"**.
- **Accepted tab**: switching to a tab refetches its list ("Processing..." while loading). The row
  actions are **Reject** and **Cancel**. The row's relative time ("2 minutes ago") follows the
  request's `timestamp`, not `reviewedAt`.
- **Cancel** (accepted tab) sends `POST …/handle` `{"status":"pending","userId":"<user _id>"}` →
  `200 {}`, refetches pending and accepted, and the tab shows **"No accepted access requests"**.
- **Reject**: not captured. The agent's click was blocked by the session's safety check (an
  external write), so the rejection-reason input, the rejected tab, the bulk actions and the
  settings controls remain unrecorded.

End state: `TestingBOrig` **pending** (timestamp 2026-10-06T18:58:59.445Z), repo `manual`,
notifications `bulk`. Nothing else changed.
